caption: Two Grafana dashboards, Retries and Envoy Circuit Breakers, showing retry volume surging from about 17:05 and falling around 18:10 UTC.
description: Two dark-theme time-series panels covering about 16:15 to 18:50. Retries (left, stacked bars) shows almost nothing until about 17:05, then jumps to roughly 200,000 to 250,000 per interval, mostly Failed Retries (orange) with Retries Exceeded (red) on top. It drops to about 140,000 after 18:10 and has a final burst to about 330,000 near 18:35 before ending around 18:40. Envoy Circuit Breakers (right) shows retries for posthog_posthog-feature-flags_3001 rising from 17:05 to about 1.5 million, staying there until 18:10, then dropping near zero with a short spike around 18:35.

caption: Grafana dashboard of the feature flags service showing request success rate, HTTP status counts, response time and status-code bars during the 2025-09-29 outage.
description: Grafana "Overview" dashboard for the feature flags service. Stat panels: % Success (period) 43.467%, Requests (1m) 500K, % Success (1m) 100.000%, HTTP 1/2xx (1m) 498K, HTTP 3xx N/A, HTTP 4xx 2K, HTTP 5xx 0 (the last values are after recovery). The Response Time graph (p50, p90, p95, p99) jumps from near zero to about 2 s at roughly 16:30, peaks near 3.8 s for p99 around 17:00, stays about 1 s through 18:30, spikes to about 4.5 s near 18:38, then drops to zero. Responses by Status Code shows red 504 bars starting around 16:40, rising to about 100000 by 17:00 and about 200000-235000 per interval until roughly 18:35, then falling sharply, consistent with the 18:46 UTC restoration. A tooltip shows an envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_total query.
